commits.subject: test(proxy): cover the connect, write, read and total timeouts
feat(proxy): enforce the write and total timeouts with a watchdog
test(proxy): cover backend failures before the response
feat(proxy): report failures before the response by kind
fix(proxy): report a deadline that fires before the relay as a 504
revert(proxy): drop the pre-relay deadline check pending a decision

red_evidence.red_output: AssertionError: the backend observed its connection closed (23.2 s)

review_outcome.detail: host decision (recommended option): FND-001 fixed by an independent host-dispatched fixer in the lane, tests first (736691e test, b6f88f5 fix: headers computed into PendingResponseHeaders, one final throwIfFired before res.status; the 504 carries no backend headers). FND-103 accepted as the documented hand-off boundary. Lane full build 4624 tests, 0 failures. Original worker outcome was NEEDS_USER (earlier-fix-majority gate).

intentionally_empty.note: Some criteria already held at base or were satisfied by the earlier requirement in this wave. Their tests are regression guards with no red run of their own.

items.evidence: The accessors and defaults already existed. ProxyTimeoutsTest:81 and :83 are green.
TlsConnector already mapped a handshake SO_TIMEOUT to CONNECT_TIMEOUT. ProxyTimeoutsTest:128 is green.
With no watchdog at base there was no WRITE_TIMEOUT at all, so this is a guard test. ProxyTimeoutsTest:195 is green.
This already held through the FR-PROXY-016 READ_TIMEOUT path. ProxyTimeoutsTest:362 is green.
The default 502 page already named neither the host nor the port. ProxyErrorsTest:143 is green.
The backend drains the body, so no write fails and the normal path relays the 401. ProxyErrorsTest:211 is green.
FR-PROXY-017's FiredGuard and settle already keep WRITE_TIMEOUT and TOTAL_TIMEOUT. ProxyErrorsTest:317 and :325 are green.

srs_deltas.text: Define 'handed to res.relay' as the point after the proxy's final deadline check, which runs before the response status and headers are set. A deadline that fires after that point takes the FR-PROXY-016 abort-and-log path. This is FND-103, residual with a recommended answer.

FND-001 is still open. A deadline that fires between the head read and res.relay gives an aborted 200 instead of a 504. Evidence: the reviewer's probe, a Response wrapper that stalls 1500 ms in res.status with totalTimeout(1s), returned 200, aborted, errors=[]. Round-1 test fr_PROXY_017_AC7_AC8_aTotalTimeoutAfterTheHeadButBeforeTheRelayIsA504 was red at d9f12c3 and was reverted along with its fix.

The total timeout also ends a request whose client body is still trickling in. It fails at the first client read after the deadline. Test: fr_PROXY_017_AC8_theTotalTimeoutEndsATrickledClientBody (ProxyTimeoutsTest:306).
A read timeout while reading the response head is now 504 READ_TIMEOUT, not plain 502. A connect SocketTimeoutException is 504 CONNECT_TIMEOUT. This closes the limit wave-17 declared.
A read timeout during the early-response read after a failed body write is reported as INVALID_RESPONSE, not READ_TIMEOUT, because no complete head arrived.

LP-1 is closed. ProxyTimeoutsTest:362 (read timeout) and ProxyTimeoutsTest:370 (total timeout), over real TinyHttpd sockets on a .maxConcurrent(1) mount, show that the backend sees its connection closed and the next request reaches the backend. No evidence row for this was queued, because REL-PROXY-001 is outside this lane's requirement set.

ProxyExchange.Scheduler is the default watchdog: lazy, one core daemon thread, null context class loader, removeOnCancel, 10 s keep-alive. TlsConnector still runs its own naruserve-proxy-tls-watchdog executor, whose thread never times out and keeps the creator's context class loader. This conflicts with REL-PROXY-002 AC-2, AC-3 and AC-4. Move it onto ProxyExchange.Scheduler.INSTANCE.
The FR-PROXY-017 kiwi-coder queued update_status implemented in the deferred queue even though this run used --no-final. The host decides whether to apply it, given open finding FND-001.

test_sufficiency.detail: check_test_sufficiency (workspaceRoot = this worktree) for FR-PROXY-017 AC-1..AC-10 and FR-PROXY-015 AC-1..AC-9: every AC is cited, passed=true, 0 gaps.

notes: The Agent tool always started subagents in the background, and the harness moved foreground Bash commands longer than 180 s to the background. I waited for each one inline by polling, one at a time, without ending the turn: kiwi-coder ran twice, then reviewer, classifier, fixer, reviewer and classifier once each. The full build ran through nohup to a log file and was polled the same way.

The full build used --continue. The proxy module re-ran its tests (532). The other modules were UP-TO-DATE, and their stored results count toward the 4622 total, which is baseline 4598 plus 24 new tests.
Every commit carries REQ, Commit-Kind, Orch-Run, Orch-Wave, Orch-Stage and Orch-Lane, checked with git log --format='%(trailers)'.
